# Purpose
The Purpose of this document is to categorize the indent category on the permission based.

# Business Requirement
At present we need to provision the filter the data of

# Scope
This document contains the below scope:
• Required new development which will provide different visibility in Pending MRP list against granted permission.
• Require Floating filter on pending MRP list also need to add Status, Summary buyer order ref, OC type in pending MRP list.

# Solution

## MRP list visibility based on Category permission
Scope : We need to categorize the MRP levels on the basis of category permission.

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 6 rows · columns: User have options to run the MRP. (text), Column 2 (empty), Column 3 (empty) · identifiers: User have options to run the MRP.]
| User have options to run the MRP. | Column 2 | Column 3 |
| 1. Sourcing --> Indent --> List |  |  |
| 2. Sourcing --> Indent --> User Indent List |  |  |
| 3. Sourcing --> Indent --> Indent Fulfilment Status |  |  |
| 4. Catelog --> NewBOM |  |  |
| 5. Sales--> Purchase Order from Buyer (OC) List. |  |  |
| 6. Sourcing --> Material Requirement Planning |  |  |
Whenever user will run the MRP at initially stage then system has to direct the page first on material requirement planning for "Add to Existing MRL group" & "Set Material. But if we need to run the MRP for generated indent then we have to do it directly from above given option and then will be direct it to MRP level wise page.
After filling this information system will direct it to MRP level wise page as per given below scenarios.
For below cases system has to show the indents from level 1 as we defined for all given cases.
Suppose we run the MRP for all level then system generate the four level as per our scenario.

For Example: -
Step 1 : -User have the permission of yarn category only and now user wants to run MRP from Indent list then we need a provision of Run MRP tool where user can run the MRP.
Step 2: After run the MRP system will open the MRP levels for Yarn category as well as Fiber also because the category indents are dependent on yarn.
Note :- Total Unit will be comes on the basis of parent line (Production BOM) which is now yarn as per below case.
We need the run MRP provision & MRL group number fields in below given transaction
Sourcing --> Indent --> List
Sourcing --> Indent --> User Indent List
Sourcing --> Indent --> Indent Fulfilment Status
We need following changes over Indent Fulfilment status screen.
• We need header tool on footer level and it will work on the basis of user permission for menu. i.e. if we have given the permission of purchase order then system has to only PO tool and it will be working same like another tool.
Note : It will be work on the based on following criteria’s :-
• Company
• Division
• Buyer/Supplier Folder
• Category
• Catalog folder
• Indent assigned to User
Acceptance Criteria:
• In this we have to check the child indent level assigned to user with logged in user and if both will same then user can take action for Indent fulfillment in the MRP otherwise the Run MRP button and other fulfillment option will be disable for that indent.
• The main run MRP button will be visible where user have the permission of all level categories.

## Required floating filter and some more columns in pending MRP List
• Status: - It should be OC/MRL/Sample Order (Status).
• Summary Buyer Order Ref Number: - Require in pending list.
• Order Type: - Summary OC Type.
• In pending MRP list not show closed, cancel OC by default, if user want to search they can search it.
Also, Level Wise MRP need to open in new tab, because for every MRP User Clicks increasing.
This page still in same status and level wise mrp need to open in new tab.
